infobox.usage: Unlocks the storage room inside the "AΠTEKA" (Pharmacy) store on second floor of the shopping mall on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The ULTRA medical storage key (ULTRA med.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the ULTRA shopping mall medical storage room.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- Requires the Interchange power station switch to be on in order to be used

sections.heading: Key location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the storage room inside the "AΠTEKA" (Pharmacy) store on the second floor of the shopping mall on Interchange.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text: - Loose loot (Valuables, Meds, Medical supplies, Stimulants)
